title: Fixed Open Cockpit Bumper Car
description: One newly authored complete static bumper-car exterior: one continuous rounded low hull with a genuine open cockpit and integral thick floor/foredeck, a complete broad oval buffer ring around the whole perimeter, low chassis and three small fixed grounded wheels, a broad dark seat with inclined back, tilted three-spoke steering ring on a supported column and one tall rear pickup mast ending in a small contact shoe. All complete numeric geometry is newly authored; no old sit-down racing cabinet is stripped of its screen, and no trailer or scooter shell is repurposed. The low enclosing oval buffer/hull and rear mast form a coherent distinct whole ride-car silhouette. Three opaque untextured solid PBR roles; metres, Z up, full horizontally centred bounds and ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes, no independent seat/pole counts. Fixed unoccupied exterior only: no ceiling/floor power network, current collection, motor, steering or collision function, ride trajectory, padding performance, passenger fit, restraint, loading, road use or safety claim.
